purpose: Test whether point-in-time promoter accumulation, reconstructed only from official NSE shareholding filings known by the anchor, improves 3-year multibagger concentration or downside filtering.
entry_rule: first valid NSE EQ trading day strictly after anchor_date
outcome_rule: last valid NSE EQ trading day on or before outcome_target_date

shareholding_window.point_in_time_rule: period_end <= anchor and version_known_at <= anchor; use revision/broadcast date when available; submission date only as fallback
shareholding_window.post_anchor_revision_rule: reject any revision or rebroadcast first known after anchor

predictor.score_rule: use existing frozen rk_mie_scoring.json bands without modification
predictor.rank_rule: component fraction descending, raw promoter_holding_change_pp_4q descending, symbol ascending

explicit_non_claims: Promoter holding change is not the full Smart Money pillar.
No FII, DII, mutual-fund or institutional-breadth inference is permitted from public-shareholding totals.
No score uplift to the official 100-point engine is permitted from this single holdout.
No causal or alpha claim is permitted from one anchor.

outcome_safety.corporate_actions: split/bonus and other deterministic factors only; unresolved material actions fail closed
outcome_safety.missing_exit: retain as missing/delisted status, do not silently impute

evaluation.decision_rule: A positive diagnostic requires better 5x concentration or mean multiple without materially worsening loss rate (>5pp adverse) and without negative rank correlation. Otherwise keep promoter change as context only and make no weight increase.
